en.hook: Resolve SLA breaches caused by task stragglers with Spark AQE skew join optimization.
en.body:
Resolve SLA breaches caused by task stragglers with Spark AQE skew join optimization. Split skewed shuffle partitions to cut runtimes and stop compute cost waste.

Operational proof is in the GitHub repository referenced in this post.
en.cta: Read the full article on the site, then open GitHub for operational proof.
